rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose casual expression when someone is extremely frightened or horrified.

example.english: They were aghast when they saw the scene of the accident.
example.traditional: 佢見到車禍現場，驚到震。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gin3 dou2 ce1 wo6 jin6 coeng4 geng1 dou3 zan3

rows.note: Use this when the horror or shock leaves someone stunned and unable to react.

example.english: They were aghast at the news and could not even say a word.
example.traditional: 聽到個消息，佢嚇到呆咗，連一句話都講唔出。
example.jyutping: teng1 dou3 go3 siu1 sik1 keoi5 haak3 dou3 ngoi4 zo2 lin4 jat1 geoi3 waa6 dou1 gong2 m4 ceot1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on being stunned with amazement or disbelief rather than on fear itself.

example.english: They were aghast at the amount on the bill.
example.traditional: 佢睇完張單上面個數目，目瞪口呆。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tai2 jyun4 zoeng1 daan1 soeng6 min6 go3 sou3 muk6 muk6 cing4 hau2 ngoi4
